architectureDecisions: D1 — Accept optional recoveryDir on runSupervisedBackendWork, default null, and pass it through to runSupervisedTask.recoveryDir. Empty string or non-string non-null is TypeError before spawn (supervisor contract: recoveryDir must be null or a non-empty string). The adapter does not call resumeSupervisedTask. DELIVERED_TRUTH: adapterMentionsRecoveryDir false, adapterCallsRunSupervisedTask true, supervisorAcceptsRecoveryDir true.

D2 — Omitting recoveryDir keeps the current first-run path: supervisor uses a unique mkdtemp worktree and disposes it. After ACCEPTED the adapter still re-grounds in a separate scratch worktree; source repository HEAD, branch refs and working tree stay unchanged. persist is execute-only.

D3 — A second first-run against a current handle fails HANDLE_CURRENT from runSupervisedTask before spawning a new lineage. recover/resume stays BB-121. Do not edit supervisor.js, recovery.js, createBackendWorker or backend-worker.js.

D4 — Distinct focused tests implement testContract: P1 asserts a persisted verified handle and exact unchanged source HEAD/branch refs/status; N1 invokes the adapter twice and proves HANDLE_CURRENT before a second dispatch; N2 captures invocation cwd and proves its disposal on omitted recoveryDir. Returned success or absence of handle alone is not cleanup evidence. Fixtures reuse delivered Backend order/context and clean only owned matching handles.

D5 — Living docs. agentic-application/state.md opt-in adapter paragraph names optional recoveryDir persist, omitted dispose, HANDLE_CURRENT second first-run, recover stays Board factory. capabilities.md A3 failure/recovery sentence names the same. No Blackboard ids.
D6 — Evidence at 5386e2ad: runSupervisedBackendWork already forwards model, maxAttempts, timeoutMs, permissionProfile, env, eventSinks, tracer, invocationObserver and does not mention recoveryDir.
implementationSlices: S1 — packages/agentic-system/src/supervised-backend.js; ADAPTER_RECOVERY_PERSISTED. Let delivered supervisor reject empty/non-string paths before dispatch. Leave subsequent acceptedSha validation, isolated re-ground verification, evidence/publication and finally disposal unchanged. No resume call or supervisor/recovery/worker edits. With opt-in the supervisor handle/worktree remains available to the caller even after adapter re-ground; without opt-in its owned run worktree is disposed. A repeated first-run on that same handle fails HANDLE_CURRENT before dispatch; adapter preserves handle bytes. Source-copy prototype demonstrates actual phases RUNNING at ACT_COMPLETED, ACCEPTED at ATTEMPT_COMPLETED, retained worktree and source preservation.

Add P2 driver-process interruption after verifier observes persisted ACT_COMPLETED/RUNNING; verify durable handle/worktree/session bytes survive the crash without calling resume. Parent fixture owns and reaps driver/verifier before matching test cleanup.
S3 — Living docs [ADAPTER_RECOVERY_PERSISTED]: implement D5. Application state.md and capabilities.md name recoveryDir persist, omitted dispose, HANDLE_CURRENT. No Blackboard ids.
